verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 109.9 (-0.3% in a day) and momentum is 37: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,500. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-26T13:06:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Yan Diomande 84 after its 19% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 20,000 coins. Now 25,750. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 4 so far, averaging -2.8% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-29T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,500 (1.10 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,900 (1.25 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Scott McKenna and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Scott McKenna 75 Rare -46.7%; Ryan Flamingo 76 Rare -41.4%; Aaron Hickey 75 Rare -37.2%; Selina Vobian 86 Ultimate Scream -31.1%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: 1 of 3 79+ Gold Player Pick SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 6.5K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
